note: This file is a constants-only module with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines configuration constants, table name mappings, and foreign key relationship mappings used by the db_data_porter tool suite.
constants_overview: Defines output directories (BACKUP_OUTPUT_DIR, EXPORT_OUTPUT_DIR), metadata keys (METADATA_DUMP_KEY, METADATA_MIGRATIONS_KEY, etc.), available provider types (MOCK, MTurk, Prolific), table name constants (TASK_RUNS_TABLE_NAME, UNITS_TABLE_NAME, etc.), foreign key mappings (PROVIDER_DATASTORES__MEPHISTO_FK__MAPPINGS), primary key mappings (PROVIDER_DATASTORES__RANDOMIZABLE_PK__MAPPINGS), unique lookup field mappings (TABLES_UNIQUE_LOOKUP_FIELDS), and imported data table names (IMPORTED_DATA_TABLE_NAMES).
